description: Compare two to four covered cities side by side, e.g. "Porto or Lisbon?" or "Seville vs Granada for Moorish history". Gives each city's sight count, days needed, strongest interests and historical periods, share of indoor sights and headline sights, says which city is stronger for each interest or period, and the distance between them. Based on the sight catalog only: not prices, weather, nightlife or beaches.

city_ids.description: Two to four city ids or names, e.g. ["porto","lisbon"].

language.description: Language of names and descriptions: en, es, fr, de, tr or zh.

periods.description: Historical periods to favour, e.g. ["byzantine"] or ["roman","renaissance"].

trip_days.description: Days available; the answer says how much of each city fits.

name: compare_cities
title: Compare cities
